summary: Gemini Space Station, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with Winklevoss Capital Fund, LLC, its largest stockholder and entity controlled by its CEO and President, to issue 7,142,857 shares of Class A common stock at $14.00 per share for $100 million, paid in 1,258 Bitcoin. The transaction closed on the same day. This is a private placement by an insider, not a special situation. The filing also includes an amendment to registration rights and a standard earnings release. No strategic change, activist campaign, or restructuring is indicated.
